title: Days Out With Grandparents: Ideas for All Generations
description: Days out for grandparents and grandchildren together: steam trains, gardens, castles, museums and gentle trails, plus senior and family ticket tips.
intro: Some of the best memories are made with grandparents. These days out work for every generation, with plenty of benches and cafés along the way.

image.alt: A family sitting on a picnic blanket in the grass

cardText: Days out that work for every generation.

blocks.title: Scout’s three-generation tip
blocks.text: Pick somewhere with seats, cafés and a short loop, so everyone can go at their own pace and nobody’s left behind.

sections.html:
• Steam train rides: grandparents remember them, kids love them.
  • Gardens like Kew or the Eden Project.
  • Castles with storytelling events.
Free museums have lifts, cafés and benches. Aquariums are calm and fascinating for all ages.
A shared experience, like afternoon tea plus a zoo trip, makes a lovely gift from grandparents. Some memberships, like the National Trust, include grandchildren. See which membership suits.

faqs.q: What are good days out with grandparents?
faqs.a: Steam trains, gardens, castles, museums, aquariums and gentle nature trails, ideally with plenty of seating and cafés.
